{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

df = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]  # Remove QC-failure rows

# Deduplicate: keep row with highest `sample_seq` per patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Compute response rate within each severity stratum
response_by_stratum = df_dedup.groupby(['severity', 'arm'])['responded'].mean()

# Compute difference in proportions (treatment minus control) within each stratum
# First, unstack to get a DataFrame with arms as columns
df_response = response_by_stratum.unstack(fill_value=0)

# Compute differences: treatment - control
diff_by_stratum = df_response['treatment'] - df_response['control']

# Compute the number of patients in each stratum by arm
n_by_stratum = df_dedup.groupby(['severity', 'arm']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)

# Total number of patients in control arm by stratum
n_control = n_by_stratum['control']

# Weighted average of the differences using control group sizes as weights
weighted_diff = (diff_by_stratum * n_control).sum() / n_control.sum()

# Print the components that will be in evidence
print("Response rates by stratum:")
print(df_response)
print("\nStratum-specific differences:")
print(diff_by_stratum)
print("\nControl group sizes by stratum:")
print(n_control)
print("\nWeighted difference in proportions:")
print(weighted_diff)"}
